title: App Master wake decision
description: The master subagent's whole answer to one wake. Parity with the in-app contract (attention_decide.rs: dispatch/defer/asks/say/note/nextWakeMinutes) so a later replay is lossless. ABSENT-VALUE CONVENTION: every array is present (empty []), say is null when silent; nothing is omitted. Cross-field rules the schema cannot say (enforced by lib/decision.mjs validateDecision): every charter slug of the brief appears exactly once across dispatch and defer; dispatch has at most 2 entries, and with 2 every entry carries a non-empty `paths` and the two are pairwise disjoint (lib/paths.mjs: conservative, an unprovable pair overlaps); no idea id in two dispatches; asks has at most 3; nextWakeMinutes is an integer 10..240; wakeId equals the wake the context was rendered for.

brief.description: The task text for the builder: what to do, in this project's terms.

model.description: Optional builder model (contract.mjs BUILDER_MODEL_CHOICES); overrides the charter default unless the brief pins a model. null or absent = the charter default. claude-opus-5 is the retired id, accepted as an alias of claude-opus-5-5.

paths.description: Repo-relative path prefixes or globs the builder will touch. Optional for a single dispatch; REQUIRED and non-empty on every entry when there are two (a council review needs none), and the two must be disjoint when they target the same repo. dispatch refuses `paths overlap` against any live run targeting the same repo root, in any project; absent means the whole repo.

repo.description: The repo the builder works and merges in: `self` (the default) or a key of the brief's `repos`. decide refuses an unknown key; a council review runs in `self` only.

featureSlug.description: The dev_use_cases slug a council review (council-lite-review / council-review: REQUIRED) or a rework delivery (optional) is about.

note.description: The coverage note: what this wake covered and left. The next wake's context quotes it.

plan.description: OPTIONAL top-level key: REQUIRED on a PLAN WAKE (the context opens with a PLAN WAKE section; the wake line carries planWake: true), refused on any other wake (lib/decision.mjs validatePlan; bounds in contract.mjs PLAN). Names and goal titles are unique. Queued as ONE outbox entry `plan`.
